000.$description: Absolute white point. Used only as a component of rgba() glass/highlight values, never as a surface on its own.

050.$description: Light-theme page and neumorphic base surface. Also the light-theme text color on dark fills.

100.$description: Light-theme hairline dividers and the cover's relief tint block.

300.$description: Placeholder and disabled-state content only; not for body text (below 4.5:1).

400.$description: Faint icons and inactive control marks.

600.$description: Muted secondary text on ink-050 / ink-000 (7:1+).

700.$description: Structural lines and icon strokes in Concept A's instrument grid.

900.$description: Primary text on light surfaces (light theme).

950.$description: Dark-theme page and neumorphic base surface. Also the text color on light/bright fills.

muted.$description: Secondary text and captions on surface-base / glass-surface (7:1+ in both themes).

faint.$description: Placeholder text and disabled labels only.

300.$description: Concept A (Instrument) accent fill in dark theme; pairs with ink-950 text (7.8:1).

500.$description: Concept A (Instrument) primary accent fill in light theme; pairs with ink-000 text (5.1:1). Also Lucent's locked primary accent.

700.$description: Concept A accent text/icon color directly on ink-050 (5:1+); also the light-theme focus alternative for indigo contexts.

900.$description: Concept A deep shadow tint for pressed states and glass tints over indigo panels.

300.$description: Concept B (Atrium) accent fill in dark theme, pairs with ink-950 text (12.9:1); dark-theme focus ring.

500.$description: Concept B (Atrium) primary accent fill in light theme; pairs with ink-950 text, not white (8:1).

700.$description: Light-theme focus ring on ink-050 / ink-000 (4.6:1); Concept B deep accent text on light glass.

900.$description: Concept B deep shadow tint for pressed states and glass tints over cyan panels.

600.$description: Dark-surface chart-mark variant of cyan-500 — cyan-500 itself runs too light/low-chroma on the dark chart surface to pass the categorical lightness band; this step does. Not used outside data visualization.

300.$description: Concept C (Aurora Console) accent fill in dark theme, pairs with ink-950 text (9.6:1).

500.$description: Concept C decorative glow, large icons and borders only (3.8:1) — not for small text or fills carrying body copy.

700.$description: Concept C primary accent fill for buttons and labels in light theme; pairs with ink-000 text (8:1).

900.$description: Concept C deep shadow tint and glass tints over violet panels.

base.$description: Page background. Neumorphic raised, control, field and sunken surfaces step at most 4% lightness from this value; elevation reads through shadow tokens plus that small fill step, never a large fill change.

raised.$description: Neumorphic raised panels, cards and buttons. Small fill step (<=4% lightness) above surface-base. Pair with shadow-raised-md (or shadow.neu-raised for legacy).

sunken.$description: Neumorphic wells: track grooves and pressed states. Small fill step below surface-base. Pair with shadow-inset (or shadow.neu-inset for legacy).

control.$description: Rest fill for neumorphic controls (buttons, toggles, segmented controls). Pair with shadow-raised-md at rest, shadow-raised-hover on hover, shadow-inset when pressed.

field.$description: Recessed field and well fill for inputs and wells. Pair with shadow-inset-soft. Add a 1px boundary border for 3:1 contrast (WCAG 1.4.11).

input.$description: Text input fill. Pair with shadow-inset-soft and a 1px boundary border for 3:1 contrast (WCAG 1.4.11).

surface.$description: Frosted glass panel fill. Always paired with backdrop-filter: blur(var(--blur-md)) and glass-border.

surface-strong.$description: Glass panel fill where legibility must win over transparency (modals, primary readouts).

border.$description: 1px hairline on the top and left edge of every glass panel, simulating a refracted edge.

highlight.$description: Specular highlight: a 1–2px gradient line along a glass panel's top edge.

scrim.$description: Backdrop behind an elevated glass panel (modals, popovers).

primary.$description: Primary body and heading text on surface-base / surface-raised / glass-surface-strong (15:1+ in both themes).

a.$description: Concept A (Instrument) primary accent fill — the one saturated color in an otherwise restrained palette.

a-on.$description: Text and icon color on accent-a fills.

b.$description: Concept B (Atrium) primary accent fill for CTAs and active states.

b-on.$description: Text and icon color on accent-b fills.

c.$description: Concept C (Aurora Console) primary accent fill for buttons and labels.

c-on.$description: Text and icon color on accent-c fills.

c-glow.$description: Concept C decorative edge glow and large display numerals only — see violet-500's own note on the 3:1 floor.

primary.$description: Lucent's locked primary accent — indigo, carried from Concept A/Instrument. Used by the Primary Direction component and, as the panel case study's Secondary, by the panel case study.

primary-on.$description: Text and icon color on accent-primary fills.

secondary.$description: Lucent's locked secondary accent — violet, carried from Concept C/Aurora Console. Used by the Primary Direction component and, as the panel case study's Primary, by the panel case study.

secondary-on.$description: Text and icon color on accent-secondary fills.

tertiary.$description: Lucent's locked tertiary accent — the cyan already used inside Concept C's own design for its 'sync' state. Gradients and secondary marks only, same restraint as accent-b. Replaces the earlier invented green as the panel case study's tertiary.

tertiary-on.$description: Text and icon color on accent-tertiary fills.

focus-ring.$description: The only focus indicator color, independent of any concept's accent, so focus never reads as an accent color. 4.6:1+ in both themes.

series-a.$description: Chart series slot A. Validated categorical (with viz-series-b, viz-series-c): CVD ΔE 15.8–19.6, normal-vision ΔE 21.4–25.7, both ≥3:1 on surface-base in both themes.

series-b.$description: Chart series slot B. Light theme sits at 2.2:1 on surface-base — ship a legend and/or direct labels with it, never fill alone (validator relief rule).

series-c.$description: Chart series slot C. Clears the categorical band and ≥3:1 contrast in both themes without adjustment.

series-d.$description: Chart series slot D (4th categorical, rose; hue distinct from the status ladder). Contrast on surface-base 4.89:1 light / 5.70:1 dark.

good.$description: Reserved status color — healthy/low-severity. Always icon + label, never color alone. 3.98:1 / 9.06:1 on surface-base.

warning.$description: Reserved status color — needs attention. Always icon + label. 3.06:1 / 9.62:1 on surface-base.

serious.$description: Reserved status color — degraded, one step below critical. Always icon + label. 4.11:1 / 7.77:1 on surface-base.

critical.$description: Reserved status color — failing/highest severity. Also the color an inherently bad-vs-good series (an error count, a failure rate) wears in a chart, per the collision rule: status meaning beats categorical when a series IS the status. Always icon + label. 4.85:1 / 6.95:1 on surface-base.

info.$description: Reserved status color — active/in-progress. Distinct from the good/warning/serious/critical severity ladder: this is an activity state, not a severity. Always icon + label. 5.92:1 / 5.26:1 on surface-base. Added for the panel case study.

neu-raised.$description: Embossed elevation on surface-raised — buttons, dials, switches at rest. Deprecated for new work: use shadow-raised-*/shadow-inset.

neu-inset.$description: Debossed/pressed elevation on surface-sunken — wells, tracks, active buttons. Deprecated for new work: use shadow-raised-*/shadow-inset.

neu-inset-soft.$description: Softer debossed elevation for small, nested wells (concentric hub/marble motifs) where neu-inset reads as too high-contrast — most visibly in light theme, where a given shadow alpha is far more prominent against a near-white surface than the same alpha is against near-black. Discovered on the Orbital Pull mark (the LucentDS logo); use here in place of neu-inset for any small-radius debossed shell nested inside a larger raised surface. Deprecated for new work: use shadow-raised-*/shadow-inset.

shadow-raised-sm.$description: Small embossed elevation for chips and compact controls.

shadow-raised-md.$description: Rest elevation for neumorphic controls and cards.

shadow-raised-lg.$description: Large embossed elevation for hero panels and modals.

shadow-inset.$description: Pressed or active elevation on surface-control and wells.

shadow-inset-soft.$description: Recessed field elevation for inputs on surface-field and surface-input.

elevation-resting.$description: Alias: rest elevation (same value as shadow-raised-md).

elevation-lifted.$description: Alias: lifted elevation (same value as shadow-raised-hover).

elevation-pressed.$description: Alias: pressed elevation (same value as shadow-inset).

elevation-field.$description: Alias: field elevation (same value as shadow-inset-soft).

glass-elevation-1.$description: Resting elevation for a single glass panel.

glass-elevation-2.$description: A glass panel floating over another layer — the mid parallax plane.

glass-elevation-3.$description: The nearest parallax plane — modals, the topmost card in a stack.

space-3.$description: Default control padding; the cover's grid-pattern pitch.

space-4.$description: Card padding; the base grid unit for layout.

radius-xs.$description: Concept A: switches, chips, tick marks — brutalist, barely-rounded.

radius-md.$description: Concept B: default card and button radius.

radius-lg.$description: Concept B/C: large panels and modals.

radius-xl.$description: Concept C: hero panels and console shells.

radius-full.$description: Pills, toggles, dials and Concept C's disc motifs.

radius-squircle.$description: Percentage-based superellipse radius for app-icon-scale marks — the panel case study's radius geometry swatch.

radius-control.$description: Alias of radius-md for neumorphic controls.

radius-card.$description: Alias of radius-lg for neumorphic cards.

radius-well.$description: Alias of radius-md for recessed wells and fields.

radius-pill.$description: Alias of radius-full for pills and toggles.

blur-sm.$description: backdrop-filter on small chips and tags.

blur-md.$description: backdrop-filter on standard glass panels and cards.

blur-lg.$description: backdrop-filter on full-bleed glass surfaces and modals.

opacity-glass-subtle.$description: Decorative glow washes and background gradients behind glass.

opacity-glass-strong.$description: Glass fills that must read as nearly-solid.

opacity-scrim.$description: Backdrop dimming behind an elevated modal.
